current.text: Mark Williams, the projected starting center, is out long term with a torn labrum. The reported timeline is 5 to 6 months.
Ighodaro has started two games in a row at center over Khaman Maluach. Their minutes are similar.
Phoenix is reported to want its top 10 pick Maluach to take the starting center spot.
Experts expect Ighodaro and Maluach to split the center minutes, and the starting job is not settled.
He put up big numbers at the end of last season while Williams was out with a foot issue.
He would need about 35 minutes with no competition at center to matter in 12-team leagues.
Booker, Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks, Miles Bridges and Collin Gillespie will take most of the Phoenix touches, which leaves little usage for him.

durable.text: He is a very low usage player. He is a smart passer who can put the ball on the floor, and he is a very underrated defender.
His game does not translate well to fantasy.
He has no shooting range beyond five feet and makes no threes.
His free throw shooting is very poor, below 50% in the projections. It hurts FT% even on low volume.

tags.name: waiver watch
tags.detail: Worth a look only if he holds the starting center job and gets heavy minutes

note: Ighodaro should not be drafted in our league. Yahoo values him at 0 USD (rank 178), and ESPN at 1 USD (rank 125, 0.5 USD average cost). Even ESPN's 27.6-minute projection gives only 7.9 points with no threes and a FT% below 50%. If you are punting FT%, his 65% FG% and 2.4 assists are a small plus, so watch him on waivers early in the season. Act only if he keeps starting over Maluach and his minutes approach the 35 that experts say he needs to matter in 12-team leagues.
